errors.evidence: The description of the horizontal axis is incomplete. It correctly identifies the years 2004-2019 but fails to mention the primary grouping of the chart into two sections, "Внос" (Imports) and "Износ" (Exports), which are major labels on the x-axis.

The vertical axis is not labeled as "Внос" (Imports) and "Износ" (Exports). These are labels on the horizontal axis that divide the chart into two groups. The vertical axis is labeled with numerical values from 0 to 18.

errors.text_span: Йерархията на данните е представена чрез групирани стълбове, всяка от които представлява една от десетте държави – членки на ЕС.
errors.evidence: The chart consists of stacked bars, not grouped bars. Each bar represents a year, and the segments within each bar represent the different countries, not the other way around.

errors.text_span: Стълбовете са означени с различни визуални отличителни белези: Германия – зелен, Франция – сив, Белгия – бял, Нидерландия – светлосин, Италия – тъмносин, Унгария – светлокафяв, Гърция – бежов, Полша – жълт, Румъния – оранжев и Испания – светлозелен.
errors.evidence: The chart is in grayscale and uses different patterns (hatching, dots, solid fills) to distinguish between countries. The description hallucinates a complete color scheme that does not exist in the image.

errors.text_span: Например, стойността на вноса от Испания през 2006 година е около 9, а стойността на износа през 2018 г. е приблизително 16.
errors.evidence: The description fundamentally misunderstands how to read a stacked bar chart. The values 9 (for imports in 2006) and 16 (for exports in 2018) represent the total value for all countries combined in those years, not the value for a single country (Spain).

errors.text_span: Стълбовете са подредени по азбучен ред на държавите.
errors.evidence: The bars are not ordered by country; they are ordered chronologically by year (2004-2019) within the Import and Export groups.

The description fails to mention that the legend uses different patterns (hatching, dots, solid fills) to distinguish the countries, which is the primary visual encoding method used. It hallucinates colors instead.
The description does not mention the units for the y-axis values, which, according to the figure caption, are in "млн. EUR" (million EUR).
